thread:
maya: Quick heads-up: we're planning a staged deprecation for the v1 streaming payload and alias fallback behavior. Need docs owners for migration playbook, snippet updates, and CI smoke tests.
jon: Can you list the exact user-facing changes so examples match? :mag_right:
maya: Sure 1) v1 streaming will stop emitting partial token events for rwd models; switch to v2 streaming shape. 2) Embedding aliases will be remapped (embed-legacy -> models.embed-v2). Update sample calls.
elaine: I'll take JS + Python snippets. No canonical streaming -> v2 snippet yet, I'll draft a minimal example showing the new `stream_format` and loop.
jon: Minimal JS draft idea:
```
// JS - v2 streaming
const stream = await client.responses.stream({ model: 'rwd-stream-1', stream_format: 'json-chunks' });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta || ''); }
```
elaine: Will add Python analogue and note `max_latency` default change.
sean: From QA: we need a smoke job that runs the snippets against canary and asserts <500ms per initial response and no 4xx. Suggest `docs/smoke/stream_migration_test.sh` that calls run_snippet for each language.
maya: docs-bot, please create a deprecation PR checklist including: snippet updates, redirect rules, in-page deprecation banner, changelog entry, smoke tests, SDK warning, and release-note blurb.
docs-bot: Checklist created at `deprecations/staged_migration_checklist.md` :white_check_mark:
jon: Proposed timeline: snippets by Wed EOD, PRs by Friday, smoke green Monday, public notice next Wednesday. Tag me `@jon` in PRs for review.
sean: I'll schedule canary runs and reserve Dedicated capacity for the smoke window. Also will create a small test harness that hits both alias and direct model ids.
maya: Also add a short table in the playbook mapping common aliases to recommended replacements + cost delta (estimate). I'll draft in the PR description.
elaine: SDK change: emit a runtime deprecation warning when v1 streaming params are detected, link to the playbook. Also add a tiny changelog note in the SDK releases.
jon: I'll triage PRs. Use PR title pattern: `docs(migration): streaming v1 -> v2 playbook & snippets` for discoverability.
maya: I'll open a meta PR that references sub-PRs and contains the checklist. Ping here to split snippet ownership. :thumbsup:
